title: Understanding Web Pages
description: A web page is a digital document that is displayed in a web browser such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Mozilla Firefox.
Web pages contain different types of content including text, images, videos, and interactive elements that users can view and interact with.
HTML is responsible for creating and organizing the content of a web page, allowing browsers to properly display information in a structured and readable format.
